messages:
Maya (eng-sre): noticing a weird provisioning stall in eu-west-1 — dozens of GPU nodes stuck in PROVISIONING for 20+ minutes. Anyone else seeing this?
Arjun (eng-infra): yes saw a spike ~10:04UTC, control plane kept retrying KMS decrypts for instance bootstrap secrets. errors looked like PermissionDenied on keystore role.
Maya (eng-sre): logs? can you paste the kubelet bootstrap error?
Arjun (eng-infra): `Failed to fetch /mnt/keystore/bootstrap: AccessDeniedException: Not authorized to decrypt`
Sam (eng-security): we rolled a tighter KMS key policy in eu two hours ago to restrict cross-account usage. did we forgot the infra service principal? @Arjun which principal is used for node boot?
Arjun (eng-infra): infra:k8s-provisioner@redwood-infra.svc — I added it to the new allow list but only for eu-central. eu-west was accidentally omitted due to a terraform var typo.
Nia (eng-platform): that explains cross-zone deadlocks. the autoscaler retries but nodes never finish bootstrap so warm pools don't fill -> scheduling backlog and higher cost from retries.
Maya (eng-sre): impact: ~120 pending pods across customer-facing pools, latency spike for short jobs, and burst GPU quota usage due to retries. Need quick mitigation + followup remediation.
Sam (eng-security): immediate fix: add principal to eu-west allow list. I can push a scoped change in 5 mins. Will add explicit resource restriction to avoid over-broad access.
Arjun (eng-infra): can we also relax the firewall ephemeral egress rule we tightened yesterday? Some provisioning flows talk to s3/privatelink endpoints that we blocked for non-whitelisted subnets. Might be compounding the problem.
Sam (eng-security): yes, the egress rule was too strict — re-enabled privatelink endpoints for the provisioning subnet group.
Maya (eng-sre): deploy-bot: start canary rollout check on node pool after fix?
deploy-bot: Canary rollout initiated for node-pool-eu-west. Monitoring health for 10 minutes.
Arjun (eng-infra): pushed keystore principal to KMS policy for eu-west and re-applied terraform (plan/apply).
logship-bot: 1749991111 - Audit event: kms:Decrypt allowed for arn:aws:iam::123456:role/infra-k8s-provisioner in eu-west-1
Maya (eng-sre): nodes are now completing bootstrap, warm pool filling. Canary looks green at +6m. CPU/latency back to baseline.
Nia (eng-platform): cost note: retries caused ~1.2x tokenized GPU billing for that window. we should add a circuit-breaker to autoscaler to stop harmful retry loops.
Arjun (eng-infra): agreed — adding exponential backoff + cap to 3 retries on node bootstrap. will open a PR.
Sam (eng-security): followups: 1) add eu-west to keystore terraform module tests, 2) tighten KMS statement to exact resources, 3) run audit to list any other regions missing principals.
Maya (eng-sre): I'll own runbook update and add an alert: KMS Decrypt errors > 5% over 5m in provisioning namespace -> page SRE oncall.
Nia (eng-platform): also add an RCA tag for cost center and emit a billing alert when GPU retry spend > $500/hr.
Arjun (eng-infra): PRs: https://git.example/repo/infra/+/1234 (backoff), https://git.example/repo/terraform/+/5678 (kms fix).
Sam (eng-security): thanks. I'll schedule a retro with infra to go over org-level policy rollout checklist.
Maya (eng-sre): closing thread once postmortem doc is created. short summary: KMS key policy omission + restrictive egress rule -> provisioning deadlock -> retries -> cost/latency impact. Mitigated by adding principal and reopening privatelink egress.
Nia (eng-platform): 👍 leave a note for product that customer-facing jobs had ~30s tail latency increase during the event.
Maya (eng-sre): creating postmortem doc now, will link in #postmortems when done.
Sam (eng-security): adding to compliance audit tracker for the KMS policy change.
Maya (eng-sre): thanks everyone :tada:
